name: Rapid7 InsightVM
author: Netlens
description: Shows what a Rapid7 InsightVM (Nexpose) security console found on your devices: every vulnerability with its severity, CVE numbers, score, whether exploits exist, the port and the solution. Netlens matches each finding to a device by MAC or address, warns about new critical vulnerabilities and lists the devices at risk. Read-only: it only reads, it never starts a scan.

info.title: Make a read-only user for Netlens
info.text: In the InsightVM console (port 3780) open Administration > Users > Manage > Create. Give the user a role that can read assets and vulnerabilities (for example 'Security Manager' with a limited site access, or a custom role with only 'View Site Asset Data'), and a password. Fill in the console address, for example https://192.168.0.60:3780, and the user. The console uses a certificate of its own: fill in its SHA-256 fingerprint and Netlens trusts exactly that certificate. Written from the InsightVM API v3 documentation and not yet tested against a real console: please use Run diagnostic on the plugin's page and send the report if something looks wrong.

columns.label: Certificate fingerprint
columns.help: SHA-256 fingerprint of the console's certificate. When filled in, exactly that certificate is trusted; when empty the certificate is checked the normal way (see 'Verify TLS certificate').

config.label: Looks at the details of this many vulnerabilities
config.help: The console lists a vulnerability by id; title, severity, CVE numbers, exploits and the solution come from extra requests, once per vulnerability, the most widespread first.

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: Only used for a console without a fingerprint. The console uses a self-signed certificate by default.
